Auditor
The Auditor serves as the county's chief fiscal officer, chief assessor, and sealer of weights and measures.
Board of Developmental Disabilities
Explore more about Wyandot County Board of Developmental Disabilities (WyCBDD), the organization primarily responsible for serving children and adults with developmental disabilities in Wyandot County, Ohio.
Board of Elections
Find information relating to the process of voting in Wyandot County, Ohio such as how to check your registration status or register to vote, when and where to vote, election information and so much more.
Clerk of Courts
The Clerk's Office handles administrative duties such as record keeping, staffing, service counters, screening solicitors, and more.
Commissioners
Common Pleas Juvenile & Probate
County Engineer
The Wyandot County Engineer's Office is a made up of a multi-disciplined group responsible for the management the day to day operations of the entire organization.
Economic Development
The Wyandot County Office of Economic Development (WCOED) was established to assist existing local businesses in economic development projects enabling them to remain profitable and competitive. In addition, we strategically research existing supply chains and regional industries to target and recruit new businesses development into the community.
Emergency Management Agency
The Emergency Management Agency strives to advance public safety for Ohioans through effective collaborations with local, state, and federal partners.
Family & Children First Council
The Family & Children First Council works with state, regional, and local partners to develop and enact family-strengthening policies, implement effective community-based strategies, and enhance opportunities for optimal child well-being.
Health Department
The Wyandot County Public Health is dedicated to providing health and safety services that positively impact the well-being of all citizens of Wyandot County.
Job & Family Services
Discover information about the Job and Family Services Department.
Recorder's Office
The county recorder makes a complete, accurate, and permanent record of every document pertaining to the conveyance and encumbrance of land within the county.
Recycling Center
The Wyandot County Solid Waste Management District is dedicated to serving the residents of Wyandot County through providing information on solid waste activities, and supporting various recycling programs and providing educational presentations for audiences of all ages.
Regional Planning Commission
The purpose of regional planning regulations is to ensure that proposed lots in Wyandot County have access to suitable roads, to sanitary services or are able to support sewage treatment systems, and have adequate access for utilities.
Sheriff's Office
The Sheriff's Office maintains the County Jail, provides security for the County Courts and serves various legal papers throughout the county.
Soil & Water Conservation District
Wyandot Soil & Water Conservation District is a subdivision of the State of Ohio through the Ohio Department of Agriculture.
Treasurer
Today's treasurer serves as the county's chief investment officer, the administrator of sophisticated delinquent tax collection programs, and the keeper of property tax escrow accounts.
Veterans Service Commission
The primary functions of the Wyandot County Veterans Service Office are to provide financial assistance to veterans and their dependents who have been met with an unexpected hardship and assist with the filing of VA claims.
Wyandot County Nursing Home
Wyandot County Nursing Home is a leader in Wyandot Country by providing advanced nursing and rehabilitation services.
